full_prompt_en: A square storybook illustration shows a white-bearded traveler riding an enormous fantastical bird through a teal-blue sky. The bird flies leftward across the center with a pale head, long pointed beak, patterned copper-colored breast, and broad feathered tail extending to the right. Its wings and legs are simplified into decorated, almost mechanical shapes. The rider wears a tall ochre crown-like cap with small pointed tips, a heavy russet coat, patterned blue-gray robe, and brown boots. His long white beard streams back in the air. Behind him, a cluster of circular packs, a little cage-like device, and spherical ornaments are strapped to the bird's back. A large patterned blue-gray orb hangs near the upper right, with smaller stylized clouds around it. The ivory clouds are built from spiral and concentric motifs, and a tiny city of onion domes and spires sits along the lower-left edge far below the flight. The entire image is framed by a thin gold inner line and dark outer border, like a page from an old illustrated tale. Warm copper, tan, pale ivory, and muted slate-blue patterns sit against the clear blue-green sky. The surfaces are intricately decorated with fine line, stippling, engraved circles, and textile-like borders, yet each major silhouette remains readable. Light is even and gentle, with modest shadows within folds and feathers rather than dramatic cast light. The whole picture feels inventive and ceremonious, using ornate miniature detail and calm profile movement to make an impossible journey seem part of an ancient legend.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形故事书插画描绘一位白须旅人骑着巨大的幻想鸟穿过蓝绿色天空。鸟向左飞越画面中央，有淡色头、长尖喙、带花纹的铜色胸，以及伸向右侧的宽阔羽尾。翅膀和腿被简化成装饰性、几乎机械般的形状。骑者戴有细尖顶的高赭色冠帽，穿厚实锈红外套、带花纹蓝灰长袍和棕靴。长白胡须在空气里向后飘。身后，一组圆形行囊、一件小笼状装置和球形饰物捆在鸟背上。右上方悬着一个带纹样的蓝灰大球，周围还有较小的程式化云朵。象牙色云由螺旋和同心图案组成，左下边缘远远坐着一座有洋葱圆顶与尖塔的微型城市。整幅图用细金内线和深色外框包住，像古老插画故事的一页。暖铜、浅褐、淡象牙和柔暗石板蓝纹样置于清澈蓝绿天空前。表面布满精细线条、点描、刻印圆圈与织物般边饰，但每个主要剪影仍清楚可辨。光线均匀柔和，褶皱和羽毛里只有适度阴影，没有戏剧性投光。整幅图充满奇想又庄重，以华丽微型细节与平静的侧向运动，让不可能的旅程像古代传说的一部分。
style_prompt_en: Ornate storybook illustration gives broad clean silhouettes intricate miniature surfaces. Muted teal-blue open space balances warm copper, ochre, tan, ivory, and slate-blue masses. Engraved circles, spirals, stippling, fine linear borders, and textile-like motifs repeat across forms at several scales. Small distant details sharpen the sense of grand scale without crowding the open middle. A thin gold line and dark frame make the image feel like a self-contained page. Light remains gentle and nearly even, with shallow shadows supporting texture rather than dominating it. Profile-oriented movement and decorative precision create a ceremonial, fanciful rhythm, while the limited palette keeps the abundance of marks coherent.
style_prompt_zh: 华丽故事书插画让宽阔清楚的剪影拥有精细微型表面。柔暗蓝绿开放空间平衡暖铜、赭、浅褐、象牙和石板蓝体块。刻印圆圈、螺旋、点描、细线边框和织物般纹样以多种尺度在形体上重复。细小远景细节强化宏大尺度，却不挤满开放的中间区域。细金线与深色画框让图像像独立成页。光线温柔而近乎均匀，浅阴影辅助肌理而不占主导。侧向动势与装饰精度产生庄重而奇想的节奏，有限调色又使繁多笔痕保持统一。
theme_en: An old traveler riding an ornate giant bird above a miniature city
theme_zh: 一位老旅人骑着华丽巨鸟飞越微型城镇
name: Oleg Zhivetin
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
